mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FAVORITE F JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = F.CONTENT_NO WHERE F.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND C.TMDB_ID = #{tmdbId} AND UPPER(C.CONTENT_TYPE) = UPPER(#{contentType})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FAVORITE ( FAVORITE_NO, MEMBER_NO, CONTENT_NO, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_FAVORITE_NO.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{contentNo}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT C.CONTENT_NO, C.TMDB_ID, C.CONTENT_TYPE, C.TITLE, C.ORIGINAL_TITLE, C.OVERVIEW, C.POSTER_PATH, C.BACKDROP_PATH, C.RELEASE_DATE, C.GENRE_TEXT, C.RUNTIME, C.EPISODE_COUNT, C.DIRECTOR, C.CAST_NAMES, C.AGE_RATING, C.TMDB_SCORE, C.VIEW_COUNT, C.CREATED_AT, C.UPDATED_AT FROM FAVORITE F JOIN CONTENT C ON F.CONTENT_NO = C.CONTENT_NO WHERE F.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY F.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT F.MEMBER_NO, C.CONTENT_NO, C.TMDB_ID, C.CONTENT_TYPE, C.TITLE FROM FAVORITE F JOIN CONTENT C ON F.CONTENT_NO = C.CONTENT_NO WHERE TRUNC(C.RELEASE_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1
